WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(w) AS average_wins,
        AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
with_gap AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        average_wins,
        average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses,
        average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS gap_above_mean
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    average_wins,
    average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses,
    gap_above_mean
FROM with_gap
WHERE average_wins > (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM team_averages)
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Treat each team_id across all years and half-seasons as one team, average its non-NULL wins and non-NULL per-row (g - l) / l values, and exclude rows with zero or missing losses from the latter average. The comparison mean is the unweighted mean of team averages for all team_ids with manager_half records.
